facts.text: The hotel is a transformation of the former Charles Street Jail, a national historic landmark built in 1851.
facts.excerpt: The Liberty, a national historic landmark and architectural gem built in 1851, is the imaginative transformation of the storied Charles Street Jail into a 298-room luxury hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is located at the foot of Beacon Hill.
facts.excerpt: Located at the foot of Beacon Hill, The Liberty Hotel is an imaginative transformation of the storied Charles Street Jail

facts.text: The Charles Street Jail was designed by architect Gridley James Fox Bryant together with Rev. Louis Dwight, a prison-reform advocate.
facts.excerpt: the Charles Street Jail was a collaboration between architect Gridley James Fox Bryant, widely considered Boston’s most accomplished architect of the time, and Rev. Louis Dwight

facts.text: The building has an octagonal central building with four radiating wings, each with large three-story arched windows.
facts.excerpt: the building consists of an octagonal central building featuring four circular wood “ocular” windows and four radiating wings, each with large three-story arched windows

facts.text: The cupola was rebuilt based on Bryant's original design.
facts.excerpt: the cupola was painstakingly rebuilt based on Bryant’s original design

facts.text: The jail's former exercise yard is now a private landscaped courtyard.
facts.excerpt: The jail’s former exercise yard is now a private, beautifully landscaped courtyard

facts.text: Exposed brick walls and a wrought iron chandelier feature in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: exposed brick walls and a striking wrought iron chandelier add visual interest to the lobby

facts.text: The Liberty Bar is set in the hotel's 90-foot rotunda lobby.
facts.excerpt: Set in the 90-foot rotunda hotel lobby, the Liberty Bar draws a regular "see and be seen" crowd.

facts.text: Jail cell facades are preserved within CLINK., the hotel's signature restaurant.
facts.excerpt: The preserved jail cell facades within CLINK., The Liberty Hotel's signature restaurant, and wrought-iron work on the windows are just two examples of preservation.

facts.text: Many accommodations have private balconies with views of Beacon Hill and the Charles River.
facts.excerpt: Many accommodations feature private balconies that boast enchanting views of Beacon Hill and The Charles River.

facts.text: The Ebersol Suite offers a 270-degree panoramic view of Boston, from the State House around to Charlestown.
facts.excerpt: This suite provides the quintessential 270-degree panoramic view of Boston from the State House in the East around to Charlestown in the North.

facts.text: The Ebersol Suite has an open-air patio.
facts.excerpt: The views can be enjoyed from any room in the suite or from the 300 square feet open-air patio.

facts.text: A 16-story tower across The Yard houses guest rooms, many with expansive views of Boston.
facts.excerpt: a 16-story tower houses 280 guest rooms, many with expansive views of Boston

facts.text: Every Tuesday evening the hotel displays art from local artists and galleries.
facts.excerpt: Every Tuesday from 6PM-8:30PM, The Liberty displays art from some of the most prominent local artists and galleries in the city.

facts.text: On Thursdays the lobby turns into an interactive fashion show featuring local Boston designers.
facts.excerpt: On Thursdays, the expansive lobby turns into an interactive-style fashion show, featuring sounds from DJ Frank White and looks from local Boston designers.

facts.text: Charles Street, with its shops and boutiques, is directly across from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Take a stroll along historic Charles Street, located directly across from The Liberty.

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Esplanade along the Charles River.
facts.excerpt: our Boston Jail hotel is steps away from outdoor fun on the Esplanade and posh shopping along Charles Street

facts.text: Boat and kayak rentals can be arranged at the front desk.
facts.excerpt: you can also arrange boat and kayak rentals at the front desk

facts.text: Most rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and many have views of the Charles River.
facts.excerpt: Most rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows, and many have sweeping views of the Charles River.

facts.text: Rooms have Molton Brown amenities.
facts.excerpt: Every room has a 55-inch flat-screen TV, USB plugs on both sides of the bed, Molton Brown amenities, and a mini-bar stocked with Veuve Clicquot.

facts.text: Guests also have access to Equinox on Avery St.
facts.excerpt: Guest's also have access to Equinox on Avery St.

facts.text: In winter the hotel hosts curling on a synthetic rink at The Yard, its private patio.
facts.excerpt: Join us for a winter curling experience at the Liberty’s private patio, The Yard, from December- March. Enjoy curling on our synthetic rink, cocktails and light bites.

facts.text: Pets are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: The hotel charges a nightly destination fee.
facts.excerpt: The Liberty Hotel has a Destination Fee of $25 per night.

facts.text: The building reopened as The Liberty hotel in 2007.
facts.excerpt: In 2007, when it reopened as The Liberty, a boutique hotel with several buzzworthy dining options, it became an overnight sensation.

facts.text: Alibi hangs celebrity mug shots on its walls.
facts.excerpt: Alibi's seductive space flirts with its history by hanging amusing celebrity mug shots on the walls.

facts.text: The hotel has five food and beverage venues.
facts.excerpt: along with five distinct food and beverage venues

contradictions.note: p1 overview says five food and beverage venues; same page amenities list 2 restaurants and 2 bars; dining page lists four venues
